svg.text: The layers of solprop, and every module in each
Bands and colours from architecture.md §3 and decisions.md ADR-001; modules from src/solprop. Arrows point from the layer that imports to the layer it imports.
pyfftw; the native package in native/
B → T delta_phi, prefactor_at, the stage bundle
D → B backends.select, then the seam
X → D a saved run, through the Output protocol
2 the driver builds the grid, the modes, the pulse and the responses
3 the statistics path: a backend is handed grid, modes and profiles at construction: the one import of P that architecture.md §3 allows B, types and constants, never a physics object
4 processing.modal takes the run's own ModalTransformTables beside the handler: a general modal file records what its reference is and not the arrays, so the reference is rebuilt in T and read in X
The package-wide modules carry no layer letter: __init__.py · exceptions.py
